Stock ~$222.70, near highs. News: iPhone 16 demand concerns, Apple Intelligence gradual rollout, shares flat.

Decision: Buy. Modest position. $10,000 max per order. At $222.70, 44 shares = $9,798.80. Limit price close to market: $222.80 (slightly above ask to ensure fill) — but "limit prices must be close to current market price." $222.80 is fine. Or use $223.00. I'll use 44 shares at $222.80 = $9,803.20.

Actually let me consider whether to buy at all. The mandate is buy-only, and the task asks to decide. Q4 revenue +6% YoY reacceleration, services growth, but FY EPS down slightly due to tax charge. Stock at $222.70 near all-time highs, trading ~36x FY24 EPS. Valuation rich, iPhone 16 demand uncertain. But reasonable to take a modest position. I'll buy 44 shares.

Key figures to report: revenue FY2024 391,035; net_income 93,736; eps_diluted 6.08; operating_income 123,216.
